user.title: Set up Renson Arean
user.description:
Enter the connection details for the OpenMotics gateway on the Brain module. The integration works entirely on your local network; a Renson One account is not required.

Use a separate gateway user for Home Assistant rather than the installer or main account.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: The gateway rejected the stored credentials. Enter them again.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the gateway. Check the IP address.
error.invalid_auth: Invalid credentials. Check username and password.
error.host_already_configured: This host is already configured. The gateway reports no serial number, so a duplicate cannot be detected automatically — add it only if it really is a second installation.

init.title: Renson Arean — settings
init.description: Each source has its own polling interval, because they change at very different rates. The lower bounds protect the Modbus bus, which is shared with the three Renson apps.

data.verify_ssl: Verify the TLS certificate (off by default: the gateway uses a self-signed certificate)
data.thermostat_connected_to: The wall thermostat is wired to
data.heat_medium: The heating circuit is filled with

data_description.voltage_offset: The voltage sensor in the Renson Arean R290 monobloc may deviate from the real mains voltage. Enter a fixed correction here; it is added to the measured value (negative if the monobloc reads too high). Warning: have the voltage at the monobloc measured only by a certified professional: risk of electric shock, and the unit contains flammable refrigerant (R290, propane).
data_description.heat_medium: Decides how the heat output and the heat energy are calculated from the flow rate and the temperature difference. Water with glycol (antifreeze) carries about 7 % less heat than plain water. Ask your installer if you do not know what the circuit holds.
